title: nano-claw voice loop
one_liner: A local, voice-powered AI assistant that runs in your browser with Metal-accelerated speech-to-text and tool execution capabilities.
what_it_is: nano-claw is a personal AI agent designed for voice interaction. It combines a TypeScript-based agent core with a Python voice server to create a full-duplex voice loop. The system uses Whisper for speech-to-text (STT) running natively on macOS for GPU acceleration, Claude for reasoning, and Piper for text-to-speech (TTS). It supports tool use (shell, file operations) with explicit user approval via the browser interface.
how_its_built: The architecture splits responsibilities between a native macOS process and a Docker container. The STT service runs natively to access Apple's Metal GPU, exposing an HTTP API on port 8200. The main application runs in Docker, containing a TypeScript API server (port 3001) for agent logic and a Python Voice Server (port 8080/9090) handling WebRTC audio streaming and Piper TTS. The browser client connects via WebSocket to the Voice Server, which orchestrates the flow: receiving audio, calling the native STT service, sending text to the TypeScript agent, and streaming back synthesized speech.
how_to_apply: Use this project as a template for building local-first voice agents. It demonstrates how to bypass Docker GPU limitations on macOS by sidecar-ing native services. The modular agent loop in TypeScript allows for easy extension of tools and skills, while the Python voice server provides a robust WebRTC bridge for real-time audio processing.
features: Full-duplex voice conversation via WebRTC in the browser
Metal-accelerated Whisper STT running natively on macOS for low latency
Claude-powered agent loop with persistent memory and skill loading
Secure tool execution (shell, file read/write) with browser-based approval cards
Local Piper TTS for private, offline-capable speech synthesis
Hands-free phone mode with automatic voice activity detection

flowchart TD
    Browser[Browser Client] -->|WebRTC Audio| VoiceServer[Voice Server Python]
    VoiceServer -->|HTTP POST Audio Bytes| STTService[STT Service Native Mac]
    STTService -->|JSON Text| VoiceServer
    VoiceServer -->|HTTP POST Text| AgentAPI[nano claw API TypeScript]
    AgentAPI -->|API Call| Claude[Claude LLM]
    AgentAPI -->|Execute| Tools[Tool Registry]
    Tools -->|File System| LocalDisk[Local Disk]
    AgentAPI -->|Text Response| VoiceServer
    VoiceServer -->|Piper TTS Audio| Browser
diagram_sequence:
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as User
    participant Browser as Browser Client
    participant VoiceServer as Voice Server
    participant STT as STT Service
    participant Agent as Agent API
    participant LLM as Claude LLM
    participant Tools as Tool Registry
    
    User->>Browser: Speak into microphone
    Browser->>VoiceServer: Stream audio chunks via WebRTC
    VoiceServer->>VoiceServer: Detect silence end of turn
    VoiceServer->>STT: POST audio bytes
    STT->>VoiceServer: Return transcribed text
    VoiceServer->>Agent: POST transcribed text
    Agent->>LLM: Send prompt with context
    LLM->>Agent: Return response or tool call
    alt Tool Call Required
        Agent->>Browser: Send approval request via WebSocket
        Browser->>User: Display approval card
        User->>Browser: Approve or Reject
        Browser->>Agent: Send decision
        alt Approved
            Agent->>Tools: Execute tool
            Tools->>Agent: Return result
            Agent->>LLM: Send tool result
            LLM->>Agent: Return final text response
        end
    else Direct Response
        Agent->>VoiceServer: Return text response
    end
    VoiceServer->>VoiceServer: Generate speech via Piper TTS
    VoiceServer->>Browser: Stream audio via WebRTC
    Browser->>User: Play audio response
